What every garlic winner shares

All 84 hits tagged on 36 variables and weighed by real spend ($2.83M). Full tables below. #36 alone is 20% of spend, so shares are also given without it ("ex #36").

Who we sell to

A man 45 to 65 scared his body is quitting

  • 58 of 84 leads are men (67% of spend ex #36), scared it shows in front of the people he loves: grandson, wife, kids, crew.
  • Women leads are mostly the wife watching it happen (#3, #26, #33, #74) or a healer / expert.
  • What he wants back: to be there, to be respected, to work again. Not a number.
The lanes

Heart scare leads, ED makes the most hits

  • Clogged arteries / heart scare: 12 ads, 33% of spend (#36, #4).
  • ED / bedroom: 17 ads, the biggest lane ex #36 (20%), but mostly small ads and sex-hook flags.
  • Also hitting: tinnitus (Stevan owns it), prostate, looking younger, longevity, eyesight.
The format

Realistic movies scale steadily

  • Realistic movie: 21 hits, 31% of spend ex #36, best hook and hold (59% / 59%).
  • Pixar-style cartoon story: 19 hits (Peter's confessions). Skeleton explainer: #36 only.
  • All 5 AI songs sit in the bottom 20. BOF sale has the best CPA but Elon said no more BOF / MOF (Oct 13).
The hook

Mid-conflict dialogue or a watchable promise

  • "Dad, over here. / I'm fine, just the flight." (#4, 67% hook)
  • "This is how clean your arteries get when you take aged garlic every morning for two weeks straight." (#36)
  • Templates: "If a [job] who [problem] took aged garlic for X days", license / age reveal, "There is no cure for chronic tinnitus".
The mechanism

Aged in darkness, S-Allyl Cysteine, scrape and melt

  • Calcium and cholesterol in the artery walls, aged garlic turns into S-Allyl Cysteine, scrapes the calcium, melts the cholesterol.
  • Knock: raw garlic, garlic oil, yellow softgels, beetroot, pills that "manage the number".
  • Under v2 the mechanism is spoken by a character, never on screen.
The close

Guarantee and scarcity, not discounts

  • 30-day guarantee in 65% of spend; "up to 70% off" in only 18%.
  • "Fermentation takes 20 months, can't be rushed, when a batch is gone..." is the standard close, but "20 months" is ON HOLD.
  • Hook and hold rates don't predict spend here.

Garlic rules to strip when porting

Most garlic hits ran before these rules. Port the structure, leave these parts behind. Full detail and the swap table in aog.md and resilia-brand.md.

Nov 3: garlic v2 RED
  • No cure, treat, prevent, reverse. The product never lowers a number. No BP or cholesterol number anywhere, monitors included.
  • No drug named, no pills stopped. No doctor as the authority, no "doctor" word unless it's the storyline.
  • Mechanism spoken by a character, never on screen. No "clinically proven", no invented studies. No competitor or Amazon in a knock.
Nov 3: the BP arc (YELLOW A)
  • Open "It keeps creeping up." Close "My numbers are back where they should be." Mechanism and DAY cards in between.
  • The product never shares a sentence or scene with the result. He keeps his pills.
  • ON HOLD until the supplier confirms: "20 months", "own cellars", the dose. Never "full 20 months".
Nov 4: US origin
  • No US flags anywhere, no FDA marks, no "made in the USA", "American company", "ships from the US", "lab-tested in the USA".
  • OK: "Third-party tested for purity and potency". 48 of 84 garlic hits break this.
Oct: brand line
  • No sexual content as the hook (many ED hits break it), no religion, ethnicity or origin as the reason it works (Japanese, Amish, Korean, "as a Black researcher").
  • No one implied to be the founder (#10, #13, #17). No real people. Screenshot test: would Johnathan want his name under it?
